title: Replication code and Supplementary Material: Algerian green hydrogen export costs and security premiums under Strait of Hormuz disruptions
description: Bottom-up delivered-cost model, scenario Monte Carlo simulation, competitor break-even analysis and econometric scripts (DCC-MIDAS-X, TVP-VAR frequency connectedness, mediation and IV robustness) accompanying the article. All inputs are documented with their sources in params/; outputs are regenerated by src/mcc_simulation.py.
